headline: Donkey Kong - where Mario was born
title: Donkey Kong 1981 Facts | Mario First Appearance | Classic Games
video_script: Did you know Mario's very first game was not a Mario game? It was Donkey Kong, an arcade game from Nintendo in nineteen eighty one. Mario was the hero, back then sometimes called Jumpman, climbing up to save Pauline from a giant gorilla called Donkey Kong. It was designed by Shigeru Miyamoto, his first game as a designer. Did you play it? Comment below!
description: Donkey Kong (1981, Nintendo arcade): Mario's first appearance in a video game, then sometimes called Jumpman, rescuing Pauline; designed by first-time designer Shigeru Miyamoto.
